description: Clones a Salesforce opportunity, with optional name, close date, and stage changes, and optionally copies its product line items. The opportunity is created before products are copied, so a later failure can leave a partial clone.

clone_products.description: Whether to clone the opportunity's products (line items). Set to false to clone only the opportunity.
clone_products.human_parameter_description: Decide whether to copy the opportunity's products (line items) into the clone. Turn this off to create just the opportunity without its products.
clone_products.title: Clone Products

close_date.description: Close date for the cloned opportunity in YYYY-MM-DD format. If not specified, uses original close date.
close_date.human_parameter_description: The expected close date for the new opportunity (YYYY-MM-DD). Leave empty to reuse the original close date.
close_date.title: Close Date

new_name.description: Name for the cloned opportunity. If not specified, will append 'Clone of' to original name.
new_name.human_parameter_description: The name you want to give the new, cloned opportunity. Leave blank to automatically use 'Clone of [original name]'.
new_name.title: New Name

opportunity_id.description: The ID of the opportunity to clone.
opportunity_id.human_parameter_description: The unique ID of the opportunity you want to clone. You can copy this from the opportunity's URL in Salesforce.
opportunity_id.title: Opportunity Id

stage_name.description: Stage for the cloned opportunity. If not specified, uses original stage.
stage_name.human_parameter_description: The sales stage you want to set for the cloned opportunity. Leave blank to keep the same stage as the original.
stage_name.title: Stage Name

name: clone_opportunity_with_products

CloneOpportunityWithProductsResponse.description: Response from cloning an opportunity record via Salesforce REST API

errors.description: Array of error objects. Empty array if the operation was successful
errors.title: Errors

id.description: The Salesforce ID of the newly created opportunity record (18-character format)
id.title: Id

success.description: Indicates whether the create operation was successful
success.title: Success

CloneOpportunityWithProductsResponse.title: CloneOpportunityWithProductsResponse

SalesforceError.description: Represents an error returned by the Salesforce API

errorCode.description: Salesforce error code identifier (e.g., REQUIRED_FIELD_MISSING, INVALID_FIELD)
errorCode.title: Error Code

fields.description: Array of field names that caused the error
fields.title: Fields

message.description: Human-readable error message describing what went wrong
message.title: Message

SalesforceError.title: SalesforceError
